_about: Splat Worlds scene list. `file` is looked up in public/splats/ first (run `npm run splats`), then `url`. kind: object = turn it in your hands, world = step inside. Optional: ext (full-precision positions, for captures far from the origin), lod (false skips Spark's LoD build), flip (default true, for OpenCV-style y-down captures), size (fitted size in stage units), focus [x,y,z] (offset of the turning point from the content centre), yaw, pitch. Extra local splats can be listed in public/local/splats/manifest.json with the same fields. Left out: snow-street.spz (positions beyond half-float range plus junk splats at ±131072; Spark's LoD build never finishes, and without LoD its 982k splats run ~30 fps).
